name: Process sales and purchase orders from every channel into the warehouse, production and accounts
summary: Brings sales orders from the stock system into one order book, queues a supplier purchase order when open orders need more stock than is available, drafts a Xero invoice for each shipped order, and matches supplier bills to purchase orders. Crons read and draft; a person approves every purchase order.

all.evidence: 37 discovery calls describe how orders move from channel to warehouse, production and accounts

covered_by.order-check: skill (a customer, terms or credit check is a judgment step)
covered_by.purchase-order-raise: stock-check (queues a purchase order for approval)
covered_by.payment-match: bill-match (supplier bills against purchase orders, report only)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Sales orders changed in Cin7 since the last run go into the order book.

crons.name: stock-check
crons.summary: Queue a purchase order for approval where open orders need more than Cin7 has available.

crons.name: invoice
crons.summary: Draft a Xero invoice for each shipped order, once.

crons.name: bill-match
crons.summary: Match authorised supplier bills to Cin7 purchase orders; record the mismatches (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads, a Xero contact, and a Xero invoice in DRAFT status. Creating a purchase order in Cin7 goes to a supplier, so it is a live operation and waits for a person.

cin7.covers: sales order intake, stock availability, purchase order raise (queued), purchase order list for matching

xero.covers: contact find or create, draft customer invoice, supplier bill list

gaps: Unleashed: its endpoints are mapped, but the kit cannot sign its requests yet (the HMAC signer is not built, so every call stops with 'calls are not wired yet'). No Unleashed adapter until that signer exists in core/.
Cin7 docs do not describe an order check (customer, pricing, terms, credit), production jobs, the warehouse receiving screen, returns or refunds. These need a live Cin7 account or demo to confirm.
Cin7 pick-pack and dispatch writes (carton records, tracking numbers back to the channel) are not automated. The docs confirm the endpoints exist but not how a warehouse runs them.
Cin7 list filters: the where clause for the stock lookup (code='...') follows the usual form, but the spec does not show an example. Confirm on a sandbox before the first live run.
Cin7 status codes (0, 1, 2) have no meaning in the spec. This workflow reads dispatchedDate and isVoid instead.
Cin7 supplier mapping: each reorder rule needs the supplier's Cin7 contact id typed into settings. No supplier lookup is built.
Xero bill matching compares the Xero SubTotal with the Cin7 productTotal. Confirm both are before tax on a live account.
Xero payment matching and customer receipts are not built. Matching a payment to an invoice is a live action and needs approval.
One draft invoice per order, made the first time the order is seen as shipped. A partial shipment after that needs a person.
First run reads up to 500 of the most recent sales orders (10 pages of 50). Older orders are not pulled.
Both adapters are docs-only until a Cin7 trial account and a Xero demo company prove them.

evidence.calls: 37 of 40 order-sync discovery calls describe how orders move; 67 to 100 percent of each step is manual
evidence.platforms: the vendors' own help pages for Cin7, Unleashed and Xero, mapped step by step; Cin7 and Xero have mapped operations, Unleashed is blocked by its unbuilt signer
